topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The doorbell rang today, and there on the porch were these flowers—no card, no note. Just a cluster of blooms, vibrant yet somehow muted in the late afternoon light. They’re supposed to mean something, aren’t they? A secret admirer, a silent apology, or maybe just a mistake, a wrong address. I moved them to the kitchen, where they now stand, a splash of color against the sterile white of everything else. It’s funny how a gesture meant to brighten a space can instead make it seem so much emptier. I keep waiting for the phone to ring, for the mystery to unravel, but it’s just the hum of the fridge, the ticking of the clock. Maybe that’s all there is to it.
